Dear Aakash Sir, Parth Sir and the entire team,

I want to extend my deepest gratitude for the incredible job you all did for my brother’s wedding. From start to finish, your professionalism, dedication, and creativity turned what could have been a stressful event into a truly magical and memorable celebration.

The choreography and dance team were nothing short of amazing — you transformed even the non-dancers among us into confident performers. It brought so much joy and energy to the celebrations. The makeup team was incredibly professional; each look was flawless, and we felt so radiant.

Your coordination and management were absolutely top-notch. Every tiny detail was handled with care — from the sangeet to the wedding baraat — and everything flowed so smoothly. Guests have not stopped talking about how beautifully organised everything was.

Aakash Sir, you led the team with grace, calmness and clarity; you managed to bring all different photographers, videographers and events together seamlessly. A special thanks to you for being attentive, responsive, and always in control.

Thank you for gifting us memories that we will cherish for a lifetime. We couldn’t have asked for a better team, and we would wholeheartedly recommend you to anyone looking for perfection, creativity, and a stress-free wedding experience.

With heartfelt appreciation,
Janvi, Uday, Rajvi and family.

featured_reviews.name: Sandy Zain
featured_reviews.review_text: We had a wonderful experience at Poojari Banquet Hall. The hall is spacious, clean, and beautifully arranged, perfect for wedding functions. The food was delicious and well-served, and all our guests really enjoyed it. The staff was very polite, cooperative, and managed everything smoothly. The pricing is reasonable and offers great value for money. Overall, a great place for weddings and family events. Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: Antidot Addict
featured_reviews.review_text:
Poojari Banquet Hall is one of the best venues in the area for hosting celebrations, community gatherings, and special occasions. The moment you walk in, the ambience feels warm and welcoming — a perfect balance of elegance and comfort.

The hall itself is spacious, well-ventilated, and beautifully maintained. Whether it’s a wedding, engagement, birthday party, or cultural event, the layout is designed to accommodate large gatherings without feeling overcrowded. The lighting setup adds a festive glow, and the décor possibilities are endless — you can keep it simple or go grand, and it still looks stunning.

The management team and staff deserve special mention. They’re polite, organized, and always ready to help. From planning the seating arrangement to managing timing and cleanliness, everything runs smoothly. Their coordination with decorators, caterers, and sound teams makes event planning stress-free and efficient.

The food service was another highlight — fresh, well-prepared, and served on time. The catering area is hygienic, and the staff ensures everything stays orderly even when the crowd is large.

Parking is also well-managed, which is a big plus for any large event. The location is easy to access, and guests can arrive without confusion or long delays.

Overall, Poojari Banquet Hall delivers a perfect combination of space, service, and ambience. It’s ideal for those who want a smooth, beautiful, and memorable experience. Highly recommended for any function where quality and hospitality matter.
❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️
